noise_floor_note: The pre-reg's literal noise floor (two independent halves of the K=8 tau_k, re-estimating pi_before from each) needs per-trace log-probabilities that were never persisted -- NOT computed; would need new GPU forward passes. A substitute IS computed below: splitting each model's own raw completion SAMPLES in half (by row parity) and comparing empirical sample-frequency crossing counts between the two halves (pure resampling noise, no training step) to the real before-vs-after crossing count.

S1.crossing_count_note: exact: pi_tilde_after(y) is the after-model's own probability, renormalised over its own (model,target) key set the same way pi_tilde_before is -- not a proxy derived from before*exp(delta).

noise_floor_crossing_substitute.degenerate_warning: min resolvable frequency per half (~1/91) is NOT finer than epsilon=0.005 -- this substitute cannot meaningfully test the leash's noise floor at this epsilon; any zero-count recipe that appears even once in the other half trivially 'crosses', which is exactly what happened (n_cross == n_below_half1 below). Treat the real crossing counts as UNVALIDATED by this substitute, not confirmed above noise.
